The strongest part of the course is that I learned the basic and fundamentals of accounting. We also had two guest speakers who talked to us and made us familiar with different sectors, which I really liked.
The weakest part is that in some areas the course could go a little further, and it would be good if students who are interested in specific topics had the chance to learn more in depth.

The strongest aspect of this course is that it does not consist of only exams, but includes a course project as well. The project enables the students to learn from a real-life example. Also, the instructor brought two different speakers to present their real-life challenges, and their careers from the accounting perspective. As a result, the course consisted of different types of lectures, and was fun. However, since it is an AP course, the fact that the grade you receive from this course does not affect your GPA, might actually decrease interest.
I loved the course, no weak aspect.
